data.note: Traditional mundane (Kalapurusha) sign-to-nation associations, previously an inline literal (SIGN_COUNTRIES) inside src/extensions/new_sections.js. Different classical/Western mundane-astrology schools assign nations to signs differently; this bundled table is one commonly cited assignment, not a universally agreed standard.
